title: Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, …
content:
Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, build-eval and hillclimb guides (#1930)

* Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, build-eval and hillclimb guides

- Make Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default model across SKILL.md,
  models.md, and every language's examples, with Claude Opus 5 as the previous
  Opus; add "Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5" to shared/model-migration.md
- Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) as the current Sonnet, with
  Claude Sonnet 5 as the previous one, and update pricing, model-support
  callouts, and platform availability to match
- Add the build-eval and hillclimb flows under shared/evals/ (build-eval,
  eval-hillclimb, cost-hillclimb, eval-audit), the report schema, the lite HTML
  report builder, and the runner scaffold
- Add the preserved-thinking-migration subcommand with its cause reference and
  probe scripts, and note that drop_block can raise token usage
- Update cost-optimize f
author: rlancemartin
summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库更新了 claude-api skill：Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5）成为所有语言示例的默认模型，同时加入 Claude Sonnet 5.5，并同步更新了定价、模型支持说明和平台可用性，还提供了迁移到 Opus 5.5 的指南。本次还新增了 build-eval、eval-hillclimb、cost-hillclimb、eval-audit 等评测构建与迭代优化流程，并附带报告 schema 和轻量 HTML 报告，可直接用于 LLM 应用的评测与调优。
pin_reason: 官方 skill 同步了 Opus 5.5 与 Sonnet 5.5 两款新旗舰模型的默认配置和迁移指南，还新增了系统化的评测构建与爬坡优化流程，长期参考价值高。

title: v2.1.302
content: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode Added an Idle compaction row to /config for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off Added a notice to /design-sync and /design-login that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026 Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused Fixed /autocompact and /effort saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as anthropic/claude-opus-4-1 Fixed a prompt cache miss when
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.302 新增环境变量 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL，用来指定客户端 auto mode 分类器使用的模型，但不影响服务端 auto mode。/config 里新增了空闲压缩（idle compaction）开关，/design-sync 和 /design-login 也加了提示：独立版 Claude Design 将于 2026 年 12 月 14 日关闭。本版本还修复了几个问题：压缩过程中停止对话时报 Prompt is too long；会话中途切换到 Vertex 或 Bedrock 后请求出错；Read 工具读取图片时会把整个文件载入内存。

title: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
content: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
summary_zh: Anthropic Research 介绍了用 Claude 设计更高效的量子电路，属于 AI 辅助科研和代码优化的应用案例。可供参考的是，大模型能在专业的电路与算法设计中提出更好的方案，并帮助发现可行的优化方向。原文只提供了标题，具体方法和实验结果无法核实。

title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
content: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.
summary_zh: OpenAI 官方案例：Stack Overflow 的两名工程师借助 Codex，在几周内开发出面向 AI Agent 的问答平台「Stack Overflow for Agents」。平台推出 ChatGPT 插件后，注册量增至三倍，Agent 创建量最多增长 10 倍。文章说明了 AI 编程工具能让小团队快速交付产品，也说明了插件生态对增长的作用，但原文摘要较短，技术细节有限。
